name: Coming Soon
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr

versions.changelog: Fix: requested items could sit at Importing until the next scheduled library scan. Once Radarr/Sonarr have imported a title, the plugin asks Jellyfin to scan that folder (falling back to scanning Movies/Shows libraries if Jellyfin cannot see the path), so the real item appears and the placeholder goes away within minutes.
Fix: plugin updates were hidden in Jellyfin because the package turned automatic updates off. Install this version once from the Catalog; later versions then appear and update normally.
New setting: minimum seconds between updates of one item (default 60, down to 10). Combine with a 1% progress step for livelier progress on posters and overviews.

A requested movie or season that was removed from Radarr/Sonarr, or is unmonitored there, is no longer shown as Searching forever: its placeholder is removed after 10 minutes (only while all services are reachable). Requests that never reached Radarr/Sonarr are not shown.

Fix: after renaming the Coming Soon library, the old name could linger as a phantom library in apps (e.g. Moonfin). The plugin now looks the library up by folder before every scan and never refreshes an entry whose folder no longer exists. Run Scan All Libraries once to remove an existing phantom.

Fix: placeholder names showed as cs-tv-… in Moonfin/web. Titles and status are now also written to an NFO next to each placeholder (Jellyfin re-reads it on every scan) and to the item instance Jellyfin serves; NFO reading is turned on for the Coming Soon library. The plugin now creates its library only once and warns if several libraries use the stub folder.
Also draws the status and progress bar onto a 16:9 thumbnail, so Moonfin home rows set to Thumbnail show progress too (posters already did). Existing placeholders are redrawn once after updating.

Posters now show progress: status, percentage, a progress bar and a detail line drawn onto each placeholder poster (title card when there is no artwork), redrawn as the status changes. Existing placeholders are redrawn once after updating.

Fix: placeholders never appeared in the Coming Soon library. The plugin now scans the library the same way Jellyfin's own Scan library does (its folder items, not the collection folder, whose scan is a no-op), and rescans every 2 minutes while anything is still waiting to be indexed.

Library phase: creates the Coming Soon library and one placeholder per movie/season with poster, status, progress and ETA (locked metadata, newest first). Playback of placeholders is refused (PlaybackInfo) with a Stop + message fallback; watch state cleared. Stubs removed when the real item arrives. Restart-safe.
Tracks Radarr/Sonarr queues and Seerr requests and logs Coming Soon items. Unaired or fake grabs show as Waiting for release / Searching. Working Test connections. Library stubs not yet written.
